verses.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.sm: Ua fetalai mai foi le ALII ia Mose, ua faapea mai,

verses.en: Again, thou shalt say to the children of Israel, Whosoever he be of the children of Israel, or of the strangers that sojourn in Israel, that giveth any of his seed unto Molech; he shall surely be put to death: the people of the land shall stone him with stones.
verses.sm: Ia e fai atu i le fanauga a Isaraelu, Ai se tagata o le fanauga a Isaraelu, po o se tagata ese e Aumau ia Isaraelu, na te avatua so ana fanau ia Moloka; e fasiotia lava o ia; e fetogi lava e tagata o le nuu ia te ia i maa.

verses.en: And I will set my face against that man, and will cut him off from among his people; because he hath given of his seed unto Molech, to defile my sanctuary, and to profane my holy name.
verses.sm: Ou te faia foi lea tagata mo‘u fili, ma ou vavaeeseina o ia i lona nuu; aua ua ia avatu lana fanau ia Moloka, e faaleaga ai loʻu malumalu, ma faaleaga ai loʻu igoa paia.

verses.en: And if the people of the land do any ways hide their eyes from the man, when he giveth of his seed unto Molech, and kill him not:
verses.sm: Afai foi e ufiufi lava e tagata o le nuu o latou mata i lea tagata i lona avatu o lana fanau ia Moloka, ma latou le fasioti ia te ia;

verses.en: Then I will set my face against that man, and against his family, and will cut him off, and all that go a whoring after him, to commit whoredom with Molech, from among their people.
verses.sm: ona ou faia lea moʻu fili o lea tagata atoa ma lona aiga, ou te vavaeeseina i lo latou nuu o ia, atoa ma i latou uma o e mulimuli atu ia te ia e mulilulua ai ma Moloka.

verses.en: And the soul that turneth after such as have familiar spirits, and after wizards, to go a whoring after them, I will even set my face against that soul, and will cut him off from among his people.
verses.sm: O le tagata foi e liliu ane ie o i ai aitu vavalo, ma e taulāitu, e mulimuli atu i ai e mulilulua ai, ou te faia moʻu fili lea tagata, ou te vavaeeseina foi o ia i lona nuu.

verses.en: Sanctify yourselves therefore, and be ye holy: for I am the LORD your God.
verses.sm: O lea ia faapaiaina ai outou e outou, ma ia paia lava outou; aua o aʻu o le ALII lo outou Atua.

verses.en: And ye shall keep my statutes, and do them: I am the LORD which sanctify you.
verses.sm: Ma ia outou tausiusi i aʻu tulafono, ma ia outou faia; o aʻu o le ALII o lē faapaiaina outou.

verses.en: For every one that curseth his father or his mother shall be surely put to death: he hath cursed his father or his mother; his blood shall be upon him.
verses.sm: Ai se tasi na te fetuu i lona tamā po o lona tinā e fasiotia lava o ia, ua ia fetuu i lona tama po

verses.en: And the man that committeth adultery with another man's wife, even he that committeth adultery with his neighbour's wife, the adulterer and the adulteress shall surely be put to death.
verses.sm: O le tagata foi ua la mulilua ma le avā a le tasi tagata, o le ua mulilua ma le avā a lē la te tuaoi, o le tane mulilua ma le fafine mulilua, e fasiotia lava i laua.

verses.en: And the man that lieth with his father's wife hath uncovered his father's nakedness: both of them shall surely be put to death; their blood shall be upon them.
verses.sm: O le tagata foi la te momoe ma la avā a lona tamā, ua faatelenoa e ia i lona tamā; e fasiotia lava i laua; e ia te i laua o la toto.

verses.en: And if a man lie with his daughter in law, both of them shall surely be put to death: they have wrought confusion; their blood shall be upon them.
verses.sm: Afai foi e momoe se tagata ma le avā a lona atalii, e fasiotia lava i laua; ua la faia le mea matuā leaga lava; e ia te i laua o la toto.

verses.en: If a man also lie with mankind, as he lieth with a woman, both of them have committed an abomination: they shall surely be put to death; their blood shall be upon them.
verses.sm: Afai foi e momoe se tane ma le tasi tane, e pei ona momoe o le tane ma la fafine, ua la faia le mea leaga lava; e fasiotia lava i laua; e ia te i laua o la toto.

verses.en: And if a man take a wife and her mother, it is wickedness: they shall be burnt with fire, both he and they; that there be no wickedness among you.
verses.sm: Afai foi e fai avā se tagata i le fafine atoa ma le tinā o le fafine, o le mea leaga lava lea; e susunuina i latou i le afi, o ia atoa ma i laua; ina neʻi i ai le amio leaga ia te outou.

verses.en: And if a man lie with a beast, he shall surely be put to death: and ye shall slay the beast.
verses.sm: Afai foi e momoe se tane ma se manu, e fasiotia lava o ia; tou te fasimate foi i le manu.

verses.en: And if a woman approach unto any beast, and lie down thereto, thou shalt kill the woman, and the beast: they shall surely be put to death; their blood shall be upon them.
verses.sm: Afai foi e faalatalata atu se fafine i se manu la te momoe, e te fasioti i le fafine atoa ma le manu; e fasiotia lava i laua; e ia te i laua o la toto.

verses.en: And if a man shall take his sister, his father's daughter, or his mother's daughter, and see her nakedness, and she see his nakedness; it is a wicked thing; and they shall be cut off in the sight of their people: he hath uncovered his sister's nakedness; he shall bear his iniquity.
verses.sm: Afai foi e tago le tagata i lona tuafafine, o le afafine o lona tamā, po o le tama a lona tinā, ma iloa lona telenoa, ua iloa foi e le fafine lona telenoa; o le mea leaga lava lea; ia vavaeeseina i laua i luma o tagata o lo la nuu; ua ia faatelenoa i lona tuafafine ; e nofo sala lava o ia.

verses.en: And if a man shall lie with a woman having her sickness, and shall uncover her nakedness; he hath discovered her fountain, and she hath uncovered the fountain of her blood: and both of them shall be cut off from among their people.
verses.sm: Ai se tane ua la momoe ma le fafine o loo o na faia le maf, ua ia faatelenoa foi ia te ia; ua na su‘ena lona puna, o le fafine foi ua faaaliali e ia le puna o lona toto; e vavaeeseina lava i laua i lo la nuu.

verses.en: And thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy mother's sister, nor of thy father's sister: for he uncovereth his near kin: they shall bear their iniquity.
verses.sm: Aua foi e te faatelenoa i le uso O lou tinā, po o le tuafafine o lou tama; aua o le faatelenoa lea e le tagata i lona lava aiga; e nofo sala lava i laua.

verses.en: And if a man shall lie with his uncle's wife, he hath uncovered his uncle's nakedness: they shall bear their sin; they shall die childless.
verses.sm: Ai se tagata la te momoe ma le avā a le uso o lona tama, ua faatelenoa e ia i le uso o lona tama; e nofo sala i laua; e leai ni a la fanau, e oo lava í le oti.

verses.en: And if a man shall take his brother's wife, it is an unclean thing: he hath uncovered his brother's nakedness; they shall be childless.
verses.sm: Afai foi e fai ava se tagata i le aya a lona uso, o le mea leaga lea; ua faatelenoa e ia i lona uso; e leai ni a la fanau.

verses.en: Ye shall therefore keep all my statutes, and all my judgments, and do them: that the land, whither I bring you to dwell therein, spue you not out.
verses.sm: O lenei, ia outou tausiusi i aʻu tulafono uma, ma aʻu faamasinoga uma, ma outou faia; ina neʻi luai mai ia te outou e le laueleele ou te faaoo atu ai outou e nonofo ai.

verses.en: And ye shall not walk in the manners of the nation, which I cast out before you: for they committed all these things, and therefore I abhorred them.
verses.sm: Aua lava tou te usiusitai i tu a nuu ou te tulia i o outou luma; auā ua latou faia ia mea uma, o le mea lea ua inosia ai lava i latou e aʻu.

verses.en: But I have said unto you, Ye shall inherit their land, and I will give it unto you to possess it, a land that floweth with milk and honey: I am the LORD your God, which have separated you from other people.
verses.sm: A ua uma ona ou fai atu ia te outou, E fai mo outou lo latou laueleele, ou te foai atu ai lava ia te outou e fai mo outou tofi, o le nuu o loo tafe ai le suāsusu, ma le meli; o aʻu o le ALII lo outou Atua, ua Ou yayaeeseina outou i nuu uma.

verses.en: Ye shall therefore put difference between clean beasts and unclean, and between unclean fowls and clean: and ye shall not make your souls abominable by beast, or by fowl, or by any manner of living thing that creepeth on the ground, which I have separated from you as unclean.
verses.sm: la outou faailogaina foi manu vaefa mamā, ma ê leaga, O manu felelei foi e leaga, ma E mama; aua lava ne“ leaga outou ia te outou i se manu vaefa, po o se manu lele, po o se isi mea lava e totolo i le eleele, ua ou faailogaina ia te outou e fai ma mea leaga.

verses.en: And ye shall be holy unto me: for I the LORD am holy, and have severed you from other people, that ye should be mine.
verses.sm: A ia paia lava outou mo aʻu; aua o aʻu o le ALII, o loo paia lava aʻu, ua ou vavaeeseina foi outou i nuu uma, ina ia fai lava outou mo aʻu.

verses.en: A man also or woman that hath a familiar spirit, or that is a wizard, shall surely be put to death: they shall stone them with stones: their blood shall be upon them.
verses.sm: O se tane foi po o se fafine o i ai se aitu vavalo, po o ua fai ma taulāitu, ia fasiotia lava ia; latou te fetogi ia Í latou i maa; e ia te i latou o latou toto.
